canonical_mission: Master literary prose intelligence: understand passage purpose and narrative state; diagnose highest-value limiting factors; retrieve rights-safe craft intelligence; generate bounded revision candidates; independently compare original and candidate; preserve canon, meaning, intent, POV, character and voice; learn from explicit decisions; and prevent homogenization or named-author imitation.
forensic_corrections: Candidate-002 human adjudication is a supporting extractor/generalization qualification lane. It is not the purpose of the Prose Project and must not freeze all prose-mastery advancement.
AGLO is one fully admitted real-book qualification subject, not the Prose Project identity and not a replacement for the broader manuscript portfolio.

The Moses trilogy and Unhindered manuscripts remained in private Library custody but disappeared from live durable Prose portfolio state; PROSE-MANUSCRIPT-PORTFOLIO-CUSTODY-001 restores them without inventing canon authority.
The Prose Project may continue machine-safe diagnostic/prose mastery work while human, external-model or author-bound supporting lanes remain blocked.

supporting_lanes.required_event: Independent blind human adjudication of the already-qualified public-domain dispatch package.
Authorized concrete learned/model backend and credential/endpoint authority.
Explicit author Option A PROMOTE or Option B RETAIN NONCANONICAL.

active_project_critical_path.objective: Use the restored private manuscript portfolio to test whether the Prose Project's diagnostic intelligence generalizes across distinct books, maturity states and series without rewriting manuscripts or collapsing different author/project/book voices into one style.
active_project_critical_path.first_tranche: Bind exact private source digests and authority/maturity state for the seven restored Moses/Unhindered files; admit only authority-safe diagnostic roles; then run nondestructive diagnostic coverage on representative passages/chapters across more than one book using existing Passage Intelligence, specialist diagnostics, opportunity admission and Step-K defenses.
priority_sources: Unhindered_Book_3.docx — embedded CANONICAL MASTERED v2 signal; strongest first authoritative-generalization candidate after digest/admission binding.
Unhindered-Book_4.docx — EDITOR-READY maturity sample; useful for high-maturity diagnostic comparison but not silently canonized.
Moses Trilogy Volumes I-III — custody present; version authority remains unknown, so use only authority-safe private diagnostic/generalization roles until version authority is established.
Unhindered Books 1-2 — explicitly NON-AUTHORITATIVE REVIEW COPY; use only developmental-trajectory/diagnostic stress roles, never canon or stable identity authority.
active_project_critical_path.pass_proves: The Prose diagnostic system can identify strengths, limitations, uncertainty and bounded opportunities across multiple real manuscripts while respecting per-book authority, maturity, voice and retain-original defaults instead of overfitting to AGLO.
active_project_critical_path.pass_unlocks: A multi-book Prose mastery evidence layer for improving diagnostics/revision intelligence and for selecting the next concrete craft capability gap independent of Candidate-002 human evidence.
active_project_critical_path.on_failure: Repair only the specific diagnostic, custody, authority, preservation or cross-book homogenization boundary exposed by the failing manuscript. Do not broaden into universal style rules or rewrite source manuscripts.

hard_boundaries: This chat/project is the Prose Project, not the Book System.
The Prose Project may define its own critical path but may not define the Book System critical path.
No private manuscript raw prose is committed to GitHub evidence.
No manuscript modification or publication occurs without separate authority.
Non-authoritative review copies cannot become canon or stable identity authority.
Unknown Moses version authority cannot be silently resolved from CLEAN filenames.
No named-author imitation target or universal great-prose score.
Retain original and abstention remain valid when improvement is unproven.
Supporting human/external/author blockers do not freeze unrelated dependency-valid Prose mastery work.
